lastCompletedStory.title: Update skip-guard doctrine and trace the CI lanes

openQuestions: CAM-432 (still out of scope, untouched by this PRD) needs to delete the now-provably-dead `test.skipIf(!xAvailable)(...)` gates once each binary is confirmed a true hard dependency everywhere in CI.

US-006's open question is still live: .devcontainer/devcontainer.json's containerEnv still declares no CAM_TEST_WAIVERS, so an ad-hoc `bun test` run driven directly inside a bare devcontainer shell (not through scripts/test-in-container.ts's harness) still hits the unwaived preflight and fails. This is intentional per the PRD's scoping (AC1 of US-006 names only the harness's docker exec call as the injection site) but is flagged again here since this is the PRD's final story.

AC12's 'reported verbatim in the PR body' requirement (US-005/US-006/US-007 all carry this oracle) could not be satisfied via prd.json's top-level `notes` field: that field is still null on this branch, composePrBody (src/release/pr-body.ts) has no writer wired for it (per scripts/cam/patterns.md ~line 410: 'without inventing a writer for it'), and the AGENT.md/CLAUDE.md instructions for this harness say not to edit prd.json. Following the precedent set by US-005 (a95421db) and US-006 (645dec92), the AC12 trace for this story was instead recorded verbatim in the commit message body (43a0e1f6), matching how the two prior stories satisfied the same oracle. Flagging for reviewer-judgment and for whoever runs `cam ship`: composePrBody will render prd.notes as 'None.' unless something (ship phase, reviewer, or a future story) copies the three commits' trace content into prd.json's notes field before PR creation.
nextStoryContext: US-007 is the final story of the CAM-424 PRD (all US-001 through US-007 now passes:true pending supervisor flip). scripts/check-version-skips.ts's header comment (the block right above the EXCLUDED_DIR constant) was rewritten: it no longer says capability-probe skips 'remain legal (CAM-59 ...)' ungoverned, and instead names the preflight (test/preflight-deps.test.ts) and the skip-count ratchet (scripts/check-skip-ratchet.ts, US-005) as the mechanism that now governs them per-lane. The guard's SCAN logic (scanForVersionSkips) was not touched -- this was a pure doctrine/comment change, verified by two change-detecting oracles both red-on-main before the edit (confirmed) and both green after (confirmed via direct grep). .github/workflows/ci.yml needed NO edit: it already had zero CAM_TEST_WAIVERS occurrences (US-006 put the container lane's waiver exclusively inside scripts/test-in-container.ts's docker exec argv, never in the workflow), so AC2's oracle passed as-is. The AC12 CI-lane trace (which lane each job selects, host-sets-no-waiver confirmation, and the brew-install-tmux-now-enforced-by-preflight observation) is recorded in the commit message body (43a0e1f6) rather than in prd.json's notes field -- see the openQuestions entry above for why, and for what a ship-time reader needs to do to actually surface it into the eventual PR body. Full quality spine green: bun run typecheck clean, bun test 5720 pass / 0 fail / 12916 expect() calls across 341 files, bun run check:all green across all 16 gates (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet: 'host lane: 0 skip, matches recorded expectation'). No file-size or coverage budget changes were needed (a 7-line comment-only diff in a file well under its ceiling). This PRD's next action is supervisor-driven review (/cam-review) followed by ship; no further implementer story remains.
